प्रयत् {c1c} A. To try, endeavour,
strive, attempt.

.
--2

perseverance.

Effort in uttering, effort of the mouth
in the production of articulate
sounds; see Sk. on

kinds; प्रवृत्तिश्च निवृत्तिश्च तथा
जीवनकारणम् । एवं प्रथत्नत्र्यैविध्यं तांत्रिकैः

selfsubdued, holy, pious, devout,

; 3. 16.

Zealous, intent.
--3 Submissive.
--4
Careful, prudent.

To strive,

प्रायस् ind.
1 Mostly, generally,
as a general rule, for the most part;

.
--2 In all probability,
most likely, probably, perhaps;
तव प्राज्ञाप्रसादाद्धि प्रायः प्राप्स्याभि
जीवितं Mb.
--3 Abundantly, largely.

.
--2 To

--3 To depart, go

--4 To advance,
progress.

departure.

--3 Progress, advance.
--4

.
--5 Beginning,
commencement.
--6 Death, departure (from
the world);

.
--7 The back
of a horse.
--8 The hinder part of
any animal.

--समयः

application.
--2 Incitement,

प्रयोक्तृ a.
1 One who uses or
employs (as a means, word &c.).
--2
One who performs or directs, an
executor.
--3 One who prompts or
instigates, an instigator.
--4 An
author, an agent;

.

(an arrow).

1 Use, application,
employment; as in शब्दप्रयोग; अयं शब्दो

suddenly brought on the stage; i. e.
where the Sūtradhāra goes out
[]

superseding that which he has apparently
intended for his own, viz. dancing;
the S. D. thus defines it:

प्रायः [प्र-अय् घञ्, इ-अच् वा]
1
Going away, departure, departure
from life.
--2 Seeking death by
fasting, fasting, sitting down and
abstaining from food with some object
in view (generally with words like
आस्, उपविश् &c.); see प्रायोपवेशन
below.
--3 The largest portion,
majority, plurality; majority of cases.
--4 Excess, abundance, plenty.
--5
A condition of life. N. B. At the
end of comp. प्राय may be translated
by (a) for the most part, generally,
mostly, almost, nearly; पतनप्रायौ
‘about to fall;’ मृतप्रायः ‘almost dead,
a little less than dead, nearly dead’;
or (b) abounding or rich in, full
of, excessive, abundant; कष्टप्रायं
शरीरं

‘full
of the fragrance’ &c., or (c) like,
resembling; वर्षशतप्रायं दिनं,
अमृतप्रायं वचनं &c.
--Comp.
--उपगमनं,
--उपवेशः, --उपवेशनं, --उपवेशनिका sitting
down and abstaining from food and
thus preparing oneself for death,
fasting oneself to death; मया
प्रायोपवेशनं कृतं विद्धि

.
--उपेत
a. abstaining from food and thus
awaiting the approach of death.
--उपविष्ट, --उपवेशिन् a. fasting oneself
to death, who sits without food at
the door of another to exact
compliance with his demands.
--दर्शनं
an ordinary phenomenon.
--भव a.
common, usually met with.

प्रायणीय a. Introductory, initial,
initiatory.
--यं The first.
--यः
1
An introductory libation at a Soma
sacrifice.
--2 The first day of a Soma
sacrifice.

प्रायशस् ind. Generally, mostly,

सद्यःपाति प्रणयि हृदयं विप्रयोगे रुणद्धि

--2 Satisfaction, amends
(in general).
